# Marketing Analytics

> Course preparation repository for Nathan Yang, with marketing analytics and AI-assisted coding. Current status: lecture notes, session decks, and resources available; Spring 2027 syllabus and meeting calendar available; assignments and assessment policies pending.

## Course Context

- [Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Reading order, authority, citations, coding checks, and editing conventions.
- [Course Manifest](course.json): Machine-readable release pointers; null means not released.
- [Course Map](COURSE_MAP.md): Eight modules and source routes.
- [Student and LLM Guide](LLM_GUIDE.md): Context selection and study/debugging prompts.
- [Portable Context](llms-full.txt): Generated course guides and resource annotations in one text file.

## Course Materials

- [Resources](01_Resources/README.md): Curated topical library.
- [Curated Catalog](01_Resources/RESOURCE_CATALOG.json): Resource metadata and short IDs.
- [Additional Catalog](01_Resources/00_Index/resource_catalog.json): Separate, overlapping collection with descriptive IDs.
- [Syllabus](02_Syllabus/README.md): Current syllabus status.
- [Data and Sample Code](03_Data_and_Code/README.md): Course datasets, dictionaries, scripts, notebooks, and code snippets with usage guidance.
- [Assignments](04_Assignments/README.md): Released briefs, rubrics, and AI-use rules when added.
- [Lectures](05_Slides/README.md): Fifteen session decks with complete Markdown companions and editable LaTeX.
- [Session Plan](05_Slides/SESSION_PLAN.md): Fifteen 170-minute meetings, with provisional presentation slots.
- [Ethics and Regulation](06_Lecture_Notes/ETHICS_AND_REGULATION.md): Module connections, worked example, and checked primary sources.
- [Notes](06_Lecture_Notes/README.md): Eight modules, 55 TikZ figures, worked cases, and source links.
- [Lecture Examples](03_Data_and_Code/Lecture_Examples/README.md): Executed standard-library calculations and synthetic CSV data for all eight modules.
- [Labs](07_Labs/README.md): Adapted and verified code when released.

- [Earnings Calls](03_Data_and_Code/Earnings_Calls/README.md): Verified metadata, pricing-language cases, complete Python, and interpretation limits across M2, M5, M6, and M8.

- [Class Calendar](02_Syllabus/Marketing_Analytics_Spring_2027.ics): Importable entries for all 15 Spring 2027 meetings, with topics, location, and daylight-saving adjustment.

- [AI Workflow Examples](03_Data_and_Code/AI_Workflows/README.md): Synthetic factorial comparisons, selection, reuse economics, and price bounds with full Python.

## Maintenance

- [Contribution Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): Add, describe, and publish materials.

Private links require authorized access. This file neither grants access nor makes a service read the repository automatically. Source documents take precedence over generated summaries. Resource priorities are recommendations, not course requirements.
